name: Takanashi Miu
source: The second eldest of the three half-sisters; she is a fifth grader. She has blonde hair as her biological mother has a Russian lineage. She normally refers to Yuuta as Oji-san (uncle). She has a preference for guys who are older than her and manly. It is implied that she may have a slight crush on Yuuta, as she is particularly curious about his love life.
